pilot-kcl-pvf-film-9245201e83acb791cc91.rationale: Preserve the exact inspected ecoinvent3.9 cut-off industrial potassium-chloride production from Chilean salar brine as a positive one-kg source helper. The source specifies minimum95%KCl and contains four operating/material/waste inputs and five direct elementary exchanges. Preserve those original signed coefficients and supported uncertainty. Do not substitute kgK2O nutrient fertilizer, infer chemical purity/yield or introduce a nutrient, density, water or molecular multiplier. Diesel uses the complete reviewed building-machine combustion service per fuelMJ, including machine/fuel/emissions once; no electrical-output normalization. Electricity uses the complete native Chilean medium-voltage consumption-grid service per deliveredkWh, retaining its native grid topology, losses, infrastructure and SF6. It is not the domestic-production-only mix; portfolio, import, network, allocation, geography and vintage differences remain warnings. Film supply retains the two original producer shares separately through complete native PVF film at plant, not PVC/PTFE. Both source producers and native film use the same nominal dispersion/pigment quantities; the native process retains its own complete cumulative production, internal transport, infrastructure, energy and emissions once. Its historical US design replaces global producer technology/geographies; source useful-heat versus native fuel-energy conventions, incomplete documented emissions and uncertain cumulative transport boundaries remain explicit screening limitations, not LCIA equivalence. Original final-market delivery remains separate, with every road/light-road/rail/sea entry preserved. Waste retains its sole ordinary-incineration fate and all eleven collection entries. All44 wet-composition/heating-value coordinates match native2026 PVF disposal; unknown values stay unknown. Preserve the original source generic-PVF waste model without inventing a pigment/recovery adjustment. Negative-reference source waste demand becomes positive complete native treatment using factor-1 on each original signed exchange and its uncertainty. Add no source incineration inventory or emissions, extra recovery/heat/metal credit, FAE branch or uncontrolled fate on top of that complete service. Complete same-mode freight uses the previously reviewed rail, heavy-road,3.5t-light-road,barge and container-ship endpoints per originaltkm; country, fleet, fuel, loading, emission, infrastructure and vintage differences remain warnings. The generic rail proxy is not coal-only transport; the light-commercial entry is not a heavy lorry. Keep native whole-vehicle/vessel/port infrastructure once. Source parent/markets have no parameters/formulas. Five signed site biosphere exchanges use exact publisherUUID/unit/fullreceiving-compartment ecoinvent3.10 definitions with no chemical or compartment factor. Preserve caller quantities, uncertainty, formulas, ownership, separate emissions and purchases; score/export all three returned helpers. Native biosphere exclusions and allocation/emission differences remain warnings with unquantified score effects. Only this exact3.9cutoff parent qualifies, not standalone PVF/freight/electricity approvals, the complete nitrate-salt supply chain, other releases, inverse or cross-system-model routes.
